title: Large Performance Model LPM 1.0 Interactive Video
summary: A 17-billion parameter Diffusion Transformer designed for real-time interactive digital character performance with full-duplex capabilities. It enables low-latency, expressive micro-expressions and stable identity preservation during long-form conversational sessions.
research_notes: Developed by Anuttacon, an AI startup founded by miHoYo co-founder Cai Haoyu. The project introduced LPM-Bench to measure character acting quality.

evolution.summary: Introduced by Anuttacon in early 2026, LPM 1.0 established new benchmarks for 'performance' by solving the trilemma of expressiveness, real-time speed, and stability. It remains a research project focused on digital human interaction without public access to model weights as of May 2026.
